name: Accessibilities
summary: Carries the message to alcoholics who face barriers of any kind - hearing, sight, mobility, distance, literacy or chronic illness - so that no one is kept from an A.A. meeting.
summary_es: Lleva el mensaje a los alcoholicos que enfrentan barreras de cualquier tipo, para que nadie quede fuera de una reunion de A.A.

name: Archives
summary: Collects, preserves and shares the history of A.A. in Mid-Southern California so that the record of our experience is kept for those who follow.
summary_es: Recoge, preserva y comparte la historia de A.A. en el Area 09.

name: Cooperation with the Elder Community
name_es: Cooperacion con la Comunidad de Ancianos
summary: Cooperates with senior centers, retirement homes and those who serve older people, so that the older alcoholic who still suffers can find A.A.
summary_es: Coopera con centros para personas mayores para que el alcoholico mayor pueda encontrar A.A.

name: Communications
summary: Keeps the Area informed - newsletter, announcements and the flow of news between the Area, its districts and its groups.
summary_es: Mantiene informada al Area: boletin, anuncios y noticias entre el Area, los distritos y los grupos.

name: Convention Liaison
summary: Carries information between the Area and the Southern California conventions, conferences and round-ups our members attend.
summary_es: Lleva informacion entre el Area y las convenciones y conferencias del sur de California.

name: Corrections
summary: Carries the message into jails and prisons, and helps the alcoholic behind the walls find A.A. on release through pre-release contact and correspondence.
summary_es: Lleva el mensaje a carceles y prisiones y ayuda al alcoholico a encontrar A.A. al salir.

name: Cooperation with the Professional Community
summary: Informs doctors, clergy, courts, educators and employers about what A.A. does and does not do - we cooperate, but never affiliate.
summary_es: Informa a medicos, clero, cortes y empleadores sobre lo que A.A. hace y no hace: cooperamos, nunca nos afiliamos.

name: DCM School
summary: Training and shared experience for District Committee Members and DCMCs - what the job is, and how a district works.
summary_es: Capacitacion y experiencia compartida para los MCD y MCDC.

name: Finance
summary: Prepares the Area budget, reviews our self-support and reports the Area's finances to the Assembly.
summary_es: Prepara el presupuesto del Area y reporta las finanzas a la Asamblea.

name: Grapevine
summary: Our meeting in print. Carries the Grapevine to groups and districts and encourages members to share their experience.
summary_es: Nuestra reunion impresa. Lleva el Grapevine a los grupos y distritos.

name: La Vina
summary: La revista de A.A. en espanol - nuestra reunion impresa para los miembros de habla hispana.
summary_es: La revista de A.A. en espanol: nuestra reunion impresa para los miembros de habla hispana.

name: Guidelines & Procedures
summary: Keeps the Area's guidelines current and helps the Assembly apply them through the Third Legacy Procedure and informed group conscience.
summary_es: Mantiene vigentes las guias del Area y ayuda a la Asamblea a aplicarlas.

name: GSR School
summary: Where a new General Service Representative learns the job - the link between a group and A.A. as a whole.
summary_es: Donde un nuevo Representante de Servicios Generales aprende su trabajo.

name: Literature
summary: Makes Conference-approved literature available across the Area and shares news of new and revised pamphlets and books.
summary_es: Pone a disposicion del Area la literatura aprobada por la Conferencia.

name: Public Information
summary: Makes sure accurate information about A.A. is available to the public - and that our anonymity is protected while we do it.
summary_es: Se asegura de que haya informacion precisa sobre A.A. para el publico, protegiendo nuestro anonimato.

name: Registration
summary: Signs in the Assembly, counts the voting members and works with the Registrar to keep group and G.S.R. records current.
summary_es: Registra la Asamblea y mantiene actualizados los registros de grupos y R.S.G.

name: Remote Communities
summary: Reaches alcoholics who are isolated by geography, language or circumstance - the desert, the mountains and everywhere the meeting list runs out.
summary_es: Alcanza a los alcoholicos aislados por la geografia, el idioma o las circunstancias.

name: Technology
summary: Supports the Area's online meetings, e-mail, website and the tools that let service happen across four counties.
summary_es: Apoya las reuniones en linea, el correo y el sitio web del Area.

name: Treatment
summary: Carries the message into treatment settings and helps build Bridging the Gap - so the alcoholic leaving treatment meets A.A. at the door.
summary_es: Lleva el mensaje a los centros de tratamiento y apoya Uniendo las Orillas.

name: Young People in A.A.
summary: Shows the young alcoholic that A.A. works at any age, and connects the Area with YPAA conferences and events.
summary_es: Muestra al alcoholico joven que A.A. funciona a cualquier edad.

name: Website / Web Servant
summary: Keeps this site current, accurate and anonymity-safe, and receives material from the board, committees and districts for posting.
summary_es: Mantiene este sitio actualizado, preciso y seguro en cuanto al anonimato.
